name: comfort-pro-confirmation-center
description: Appointment-confirmation automation (rules first, AI second, human escalation) with a React dispatcher console. Root scripts only; each part has its own dependencies.

scripts.setup: npm run backend:install && npm run frontend:install
scripts.demo: npm run backend:seed && npm run backend:reset && cd automation && node scripts/sync_to_backend.js
scripts.test-all: npm run automation:primary && npm run automation:edge-cases && npm run automation:workflow:validate
